Sends each item down the route TypeScript picks: route(item, ctx) is called for each item and returns one of the Routes.

| | |
|---|---|
| Type | `code.route` |
| Kind | Node |
| Inputs | `main` |
| Outputs | none, and one per value of **Routes** (`routes`) |

Items that fail stop the execution, unless **Continue on failure** is on: then they leave on the `error` port instead.

## Settings

| Setting | Kind | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Code (`source`) | TypeScript; see [Code nodes](/docs/guides/code/) | no | a starter, below | TypeScript, importing only from @polythought/sdk: dec for exact prices, data requests, and the types of every node's items. |
| Routes (`routes`) | list of text | no | `wide`, `tight` | One per line, up to 10. Each route is an output port of the same name. |

## Starter code

What **Code** holds until you change it:

```ts
import { dec } from "@polythought/sdk"
import type { Context, Item } from "@polythought/sdk"

// Called for each item: returns the route it goes down, one of Routes.
export function route(item: Item, ctx: Context): string {
  return dec(String(item.spread ?? 0)).gt("0.02") ? "wide" : "tight"
}
```

## Items

The items it receives, passed on as they are.
